name: Ash-Bellows Trench
core_rationale: Southeastern sub-kiln firebrick trench of Continent 01 where Sola's deepest ceramic air-ducts draw cool valley air beneath Kilnfire Terraces.
local_conflict: Dormant glaze-golems and ember-salamanders stir inside the firebrick intake tunnels beneath the shield rim.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Molten celadon glaze-vapor vents through the northern Glaze Flue; the Draft-Kiln Masons require the Bellows Counterweight Key before unbolting the northern louver.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Kiln-masons say the southeastern air-ducts hum a three-note chord whenever the great bellows under Kilnwatch Bastion draw breath.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Glazed terracotta intake arches disappearing into a warm, glowing trench along the southeastern shield rim.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient kiln-blueprint lies sealed inside Sola's primary draft chamber at the bottom of Ash-Bellows Trench?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin on Continent 01 Hearthbloom Basin.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Glazed terracotta intake arches and singing ceramic air-ducts along the southeastern shield rim.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 12.5m glazed firebrick walkways, 0.58m kiln-draft benches, and 0.14m brick step-risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix ([0, 1] Firebrick Intake Duct, [1, 1] Draft-Kiln Post, [1, 1] floor -1 Ember-Bellows Chamber, [1, 0] Glaze Flue Vent) with construct and spirit families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-glaze-flue-vent at [1, 0] as an intentional Mystery frontier gated by a fog_of_lore louver lock.
